name: To Seth: Anubis Side
source:
In TS:AS, you play as the titular Anubis, trying to converse with someone who really doesn't want to.

[From [url=https://saintvermin.itch.io/toseth-anubis]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《To Seth: Anubis Side》中，你將扮演標題裡的阿努比斯，試圖跟一個當真不想開口的人交談。

［摘自[url=https://saintvermin.itch.io/toseth-anubis]itch.io[/url]］
